title: Tensor model normalization
statement: For a scheme isomorphism, the recorded closed structures and K-flat tensor models [def-pod-reindexing-coherence-data, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], and tensor-chain data normalized on every actual pure tensor [lem-pod-reindexing-comparison-core-tensor-data], there exists a natural derived tensor comparison whose K-flat representative square with that chain comparison and the two recorded tensor models commutes. The derived comparison is chosen by this square; it is not an independently arbitrary isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the proved tensor_presentation_comparison to obtain the explicit natural isomorphism on K-flat representatives with its exact component formula. Its construction uses pure-generator chain naturality and the K-flat full-subcategory lift.
The K-flat localization presents the source derived category, by the proved kFlatLocalization helper in RingedDerivedTensorHomAdjunction. Its product is a localization as well.

On the product K-flat presentation compose TY.comparison inverse, the exact localization factorization, the localized natural chain comparison, TX.comparison, and the inverse tensor of the two factorization isomorphisms. This gives an isomorphism between restrictions of the two required derived bifunctors. Mathlib Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft for the product localization descends it by FullyFaithful.preimageIso.

The fully faithful preimage equation identifies every component of the descended isomorphism with the preceding composite. Cancel the source tensor model and the two factorization isomorphisms to recover exactly tensor_model. Return this descended isomorphism with the normalization data.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_core_tensor_model_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    (s : Option ℕ) (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (t : ComparisonCoreTensorData l E g s SX SY TX TY) :
    ∃ tensor : SY.tensor ⋙ podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s ≅
        ((podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).prod (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s)) ⋙
          SX.tensor,
      Nonempty (ComparisonCoreTensorModelData l E g s SX SY TX TY t.tensorChain tensor)

statement_change.old_statement: For chosen tensor-chain and tensor comparison, the K-flat representative normalization field admits a choice.
statement_change.what: The former statement universally quantified independently arbitrary tensorChain and tensor isomorphisms, but asserted their exact normalized compatibility. Negating only the tensor isomorphism negates exactly one side of its equation. At finite coefficient stage F_3 on a nonempty point, with the tensor unit in degree zero, the two claims would force 1 = -1. The source specifies the canonical tensor comparison, not an arbitrary one. The corrected theorem constructs the derived comparison from the pure-normalized chain comparison. The caller still constructs every field of the identical Comparison structure.
